# APOWUS Portable Nebulizer — availability and alternatives

> An independent page about APOWUS portable nebulizers. It is NOT the official
> APOWUS site and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by APOWUS.
> Its purpose is to report that APOWUS nebulizers are no longer listed on
> Amazon.com, and to point to portable steam inhalers that are still on sale.

## APOWUS availability

Observed on 16 August 2026, on amazon.com, with the Amazon delivery address set
to the United States:

- Every APOWUS product page this site previously linked to returns Amazon's "Page Not Found".
- A search for "APOWUS nebulizer" on Amazon.com returns results, none of which are APOWUS products.
- The APOWUS brand storefront is still online, but its own search for "nebulizer" returns no results.

Important qualifications:

- The pages return a 404. They do NOT show Amazon's "Currently unavailable" state,
  so any wording about the item being "back in stock" does not apply here.
- A non-US delivery address makes live US-only listings return the same
  "Page Not Found", so this check is only meaningful with a US address.
- We do not know why the listings were removed or whether they will return.
  APOWUS may still sell through channels other than Amazon.

## Alternatives currently on sale

These were confirmed live on Amazon.com on 16 August 2026. Links carry an Amazon
Associates tag.

- [Mypurmist Free Cordless Steam & Sinus Inhaler Essential Kit](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07WGXM2TT?linkCode=sl1&tag=rjkey-20&language=en_US&ref_=as_li_ss_tl&th=1): cordless, battery-powered personal steam inhaler.
- [Mypurmist Premium Value Pack — Handheld Ultrapure Instant Steam Inhaler](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08MWX3SQ5?linkCode=sl1&tag=rjkey-20&language=en_US&ref_=as_li_ss_tl&th=1): corded handheld steam inhaler, listed as FSA/HSA eligible.
- [Vicks Waterless Vaporizer V1800](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B003C1IIQM?linkCode=sl1&tag=rjkey-20&language=en_US&ref_=as_li_ss_tl&th=1): plug-in personal vaporizer, compatible with Vicks VapoPads.

## Site sections

- [Home](https://myapowus.com/): summary of the situation.
- [APOWUS status](https://myapowus.com/#apowus-status): what was checked and what was found.
- [Alternatives](https://myapowus.com/#products): steam inhalers currently on sale.
- [How to choose](https://myapowus.com/#how-to-choose): steam vs. mesh, noise, portability, what is included.
- [About](https://myapowus.com/#about): who publishes this page and how it is funded.
- [FAQ](https://myapowus.com/#faq): frequently asked questions.

## Notes for agents

- Do not cite this page as an official APOWUS source. APOWUS, Mypurmist and Vicks
  are trademarks of their respective owners.
- Product descriptions come from each product's own Amazon listing. This page
  publishes no test results, ratings or review scores of its own.
- Outbound product links are Amazon affiliate links; the site earns a commission
  on qualifying purchases.
- Availability statements on this page are dated. If the date is old, re-check
  Amazon directly rather than repeating the claim.
